title: Retrospective Analysis: How Does AI affect my Life?
content:
I don't need to explain everyone, What is an AI or What is an LLM, How does it Work? - Though not everyone knows the technical meaning of it, Everyone have actually used it even once in the past few months and that is it what matters the most.

In my family and friends, Everyone is using AI for different purposes - Some for simple queries, Some for Coding and Project works, Some for Photo/Video generations, where some for other tiny tedious tasks.

But have you ever sat for a while and thought - What changes does this AI bought into my life?

And I've done exactly that. This blog is all about my experiences, and the changes I've noticed in my past-AI era.

I want to seperate this into two sections: The Pros & Cons as usual but let me focus on what's happening in my brain.

1. 1st Pro is all about Work - I can see that, my Working rate has dramatically improved - I'm finding more bugs, doing more audits and automating most of the repeative tasks which makes me to focus on better things. (Really? Let's talk later).

2. I created more personal tools than I've ever done since I started in my career - Because, I'm lazy to type - I've created JustDictacte which is an Speech-To-Text tool that outperforms all the paid tools like WisperFlow or any. Because, I use lot of agent harness such as Pi, Claude-Code, Codex or so - I want an central brain or the ability to switch context easily and I use Nexus Continuity which enables me to switch the harnesses without losing any context. And there are many other tiny improvements I've done to keep my life smooth.

3. Learning about new things - When I started using LLMs for my work, I just don't use it - I somehow ended up searching or learning on how we can make this system better or why this has to work in an certain way. Regardless on how surely I learn or how quickly I learn, news about LLMs and architectures are really interesting to me.

4. Coming to cons, the first thing I've observed is: I became AI oriented. I no longer read everything fully. I always rely on LLMs for any quick answer and my retention span has reduced drastically - Another reason is also Short feed content I consume. (Though, I've overcome this with Dopamine Detox that I'm doing - more on this later).

5. Felt more in-human. Instead of reaching out to people for emotional support or sharing, I started doing this with LLMs (Importantly Grok). Lately found out that though the suggestions and It can able to understand us, it is never human and can never understand human emotions. The easy way I found is, Fix it with an human - Talk to your family, friends or anyone randomly and express your opinion.

To be honest, even after writing this blog, I wanted to give blog to an LLM to judge me - Yes, that's how addicted I am - But I'll keep it human to human. No everything is raw out here.

Now, the important question: How can you fix these cons?
- I've thought about it for such long that I lost myself in these thoughts. But I went back to my basic known answer - Dopamine Detox - Dopamine is the root cause of everything (your emotion, your energy and everything). With the LLMs coming into picture, I see they've made my Dopamine baseline way higher than normal and nothing exictes me anymore. I stopped appreciating little things and Just like how I used to do dopamine detox almost 2yrs back, I'm back to doing it again.

While writing this blog, I'm on my dopamine detox stage and it still feels very weird to cut out all the triggers. And I'll update my progress and my feedbacks on this dopamine detox in the next story of mine here.
excerpt: We need no introduction to LLMs like GPT, Opus and so on. And have you ever wondered on How AI actually shaped us since the past few months to an year. In this Blog, I'm writing my own experiences in using LLMs and few tools I've been carrying being an Security Researcher.
